title: Codex installer keeps tools.* tables but replaces other edits inside its managed block
trigger: Before re-running scripts/install-codex.mjs (or deltadictum install --host codex) against a project whose .codex/config.toml managed DD block or .codex/hooks.json was hand-edited
behavior_delta: Move hand edits out of DD's managed block, or warn the user before re-running the installer. Since 0.8.4 scripts/install-codex.mjs carries [mcp_servers.dd.tools.<tool>] tables (approval_mode and the like) from the old block into the new one, but every other key between BEGIN/END DD MANAGED CONFIG (command, args, cwd, startup_timeout_sec, tool_timeout_sec, the env table, comments) is replaced by configBody. In .codex/hooks.json DD's own handlers get the installer's timeout and limits back; other handlers are kept. Run with --dry-run first and diff the files it lists.
what: Move hand edits out of DD's managed block, or warn the user before re-running the installer. Since 0.8.4 scripts/install-codex.mjs carries [mcp_servers.dd.tools.<tool>] tables (approval_mode and the like) from the old block into the new one, but every other key between BEGIN/END DD MANAGED CONFIG (command, args, cwd, startup_timeout_sec, tool_timeout_sec, the env table, comments) is replaced by configBody. In .codex/hooks.json DD's own handlers get the installer's timeout and limits back; other handlers are kept. Run with --dry-run first and diff the files it lists.
why: Observed in Project-Patriark: regenerating the block dropped approval_mode = "approve" for orient and retrieve. The 0.8.4 fix preserves tools.* tables only; tests/hooks/codex.test.js asserts that a hand-set startup_timeout_sec returns to 30, so other hand edits are still replaced silently.
trigger_variants: Volver a correr el instalador de Codex

evidence_refs.summary: toolPreferences keeps [mcp_servers.dd.tools.*] tables from the managed block; the rest of the block is configBody; owned hook handlers are replaced in place.
Upgrade tests: tools.* preferences survive, startup_timeout_sec 99 returns to 30, hook timeout and limits are refreshed.
